notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36615701/88d97eda6e517f36c674768473683c012a171d7c.png[/img]

We’re working on the Little Shop of Junk, during breaks “Overcrowd” is consuming us. 
The hazard of a badly run metro, rat infestation, malfunctioning technology, mad crowds, heat and dirt - just how we like it! 

Love the smell of panic. It comes with a job if you're selling exploding dynamite.
Add to your shopping list:

notes.title: New Shop Coming to Town!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36615701/9698ea0c08ac07deabc6dc51747146c3cacedd8a.png[/img]

[b]Little Shop of Junk is coming to Steam and we have big plans for it![/b]

Originally made in 72 hours during the Ludum Dare jam, it was a game about selling lots of rockets and boxes really quickly. It turned pretty well and plenty of people have played it on itch.io since then.

Now we're working on a new, enhanced version of that. Check out the store page to read about all the upcoming features. There will be shop management, lots of new items and even a little bit of crafting. Long story short, we're putting quite a bit more work into it and hope to make a fully-fledged game about running a crazy store set in cartoony post-apocalypse.

If that sounds like something you'd like to play, make sure to add us to your wishlist. You can also try the jam version over at [url=https://auxiliarycarry.itch.io/littleshop]https://auxiliarycarry.itch.io/littleshop[/url] Have fun!
